predefinedQueries.queryString: select rs.*, t1.chiave_r, t1.liv, t1.folder_name from (select '€global_codice_azienda€' as codice_azienda, $folder_name$ as folder_name, $id_risorsa$ as id_risorsa, $chiave_r$ as chiave_r, $liv$ as liv, $codice_azienda_ass$ as codice_azienda_ass, $id_progetto$ as id_progetto) t1 left join entrasp.cdms_risorse rs on t1.codice_azienda=rs.codice_azienda and t1.id_risorsa=rs.id_risorsa;

select fl.*, az.codice_part, entrasp.anagrafiche_vr_max(az.codice_part, fl.id_anagrafica) as prog_vr from entrasp.folders_list('€global_codice_azienda€', '€global_username€', $liv$, $chiave_r$) fl left join entrasp.aziende az on fl.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda;
